title: THROUGH THE LENSES - QUEST 2 vs Reverb G2 vs INDEX! 90Hz Quest
summary: A through-the-lens comparison of the Oculus Quest 2, HP Reverb G2 and Valve Index, capturing what each headset's display actually looks like. It also previews a 90Hz mode coming to Quest 2.
why: Linked as a quick visual reference for resolution and screen-door effect differences between popular VR headsets.
